capabilities.name: every cut is a model crash point
capabilities.contract: Every process-death cut of the served open program after the log is recovered (log-recovered, recover-replayed and the three recovery barriers), from the recovered kernel of a related byte store, is a related state, and the owner the open installs carries the invariant.

capabilities.latest: the served open is fnn-recover-log (host/native/io.lisp), whose program is fn-lg-open-program (books/store-log-route-programs.lisp): six cuts, log-truncated and log-recovered (LOG_CUTS in tests/campaign/native_cuts.py), then recover-replayed and the three recover-barrier sites (RECOVERY_CUTS). fn-lg-open-program-keeps-the-relation-at-every-cut (lane host-model, 2026-10-03) composes fn-lg-recover-program-establishes-the-relation with fn-lg-open-suffix-keeps-the-relation over the whole program: the recover program completes with log-recovered related and every state of the suffix is related. The former keystone fn-bs-recover-program-keeps-relation-at-every-cut (books/byte-store-k0-recovery.lisp) is over the per-file recovery program, unreachable since the record log is the one format (books/byte-store-programs.lisp P-RECOVER: every store an image opens is format 9); the marker program it cited (fn-bs-marker-program) has no source in the tree. Since owner-checkpoint-open the owner opens through fn-ock-recover-extended (host/owner-host.lisp fn-owner-recover-extended), and fn-lgoc-recover-installs-invariant (books/owner-log-ocl.lisp) says the owner it installs carries fn-lgoc-invariantp.
capabilities.obstruction: three coordinates are outside the keystone, each named in the book: log-truncated (the tail write before its fence, not related by the recover theorem); recovery-stage-unlinked (RECOVERY_CUTS' fifth row, fn-bs-recover-stage-cleanup-program's cut, run after this program); and fnn-log-complete-rotation (host/native/io.lisp), which a writable open runs before the program with no cut and no model step (Codex r72 F1; lane SWEEP-STORE's fix). The per-file K0 family stays as the byte model's record, marked unreachable-in-composition in PRF-041. The host's syscall order against fn-lg-open-program is checked by native_cuts.verify_* as source text, not proved.
capabilities.next: a model step and cut for fnn-log-complete-rotation (with SWEEP-STORE's fix), the log-truncated state related, and recovery-stage-unlinked composed as the follows program, so one theorem covers every coordinate of the open; then the HM's crash label (lane host-model) as the cut's coordinate instead of a hand-mirrored name.
